description: Key handling in the main mail window. The chrome runtime matches keys locally and reports only the finished commands that run in the background.

functions.name: install
functions.description: Installs the compiled keymap, or replaces the one installed. The first call starts the key listeners and later calls add none.

tree.description: The one loose object of the API. It is the compiled keymap as data: a version the parent checks, and the root branch whose leaves name command ids. The parent walks it with the key matcher and runs a leaf only when its id is in the fixed motion table. A deep schema would copy the compiler's tree shape and break on each change to it.

holdCommands.description: Ids of the commands that open the overlay. After one fires, plain keys are dropped until the focus reaches a text field, the tab changes or 1.5 seconds pass.

settings.description: The settings the key matcher reads. It reads none today.

functions.name: viewRows
functions.description: Reads the thread list rows from first to last: index, message id, depth, collapsed, unread and the message flags word, and the current row.

functions.name: viewThread
functions.description: Opens or closes the thread at a row.

functions.name: viewScroll
functions.description: Scrolls a row to the middle, the top or the bottom of the list.

functions.name: folderTreeExpand
functions.description: Opens or closes the selected folder row. Answers false, with nothing done, unless the folder pane has the focus.

functions.name: paneFocus
functions.description: Moves the focus to the folder pane, the thread list or the message pane, or to the pane left or right of the focused one. Answers false, with the focus left where it was, when that pane is hidden, shows no message, or lies past the end.

functions.name: appCommand
functions.description: Runs one of two Thunderbird commands by name. Answers false when Thunderbird has the command disabled.

functions.name: appOpenPage
functions.description: Opens one of three fixed pages in a tab. The parent holds the addresses.

events.name: onInvocation
events.description: A key sequence finished on a command that runs in the background, or the half-typed sequence changed. The payload is output only, so it takes no argument check.

command.description: A command id, or "pending" for a change of the half-typed sequence. That event carries `keys` and `windowId` only.

keys.description: The typed key tokens of a pending sequence, counts left out. Empty when the sequence ended.

messageIds.description: The MailExtension ids of the messages selected at the key press.
